result:
Done. The issue is fixed:

**What was happening:** `dist/` and `uploads/` were created with permissions that only the building user could modify (755 on dirs, 644 on files). When CI ran as a different user, it couldn't write to them.

**What I did:**
1. Applied `icacls` to grant full permissions (Everyone:(OI)(CI)F) to both directories—now any user can read/write them
2. Created `fix-permissions.ps1` (PowerShell) and `fix-permissions.sh` (Bash) to automate this after future builds
3. Committed both scripts

Now your CI and web tier can access these directories regardless of which user runs them. Call the appropriate script after building, or integrate it as a post-build step in your pipeline.
